<reason>CON won the burden clash: PRO defended screening, limits, monitoring and security, but CON showed those are safeguards separable from requiring a therapeutic purpose, and PRO never justified the extra exclusion after safeguards are met, retreating to never/any-harm-is-unacceptable for nonmedical use while ignoring low-risk sensory uses.</reason>
